auth.name: Name
auth.totpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.recoveryHint: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works once.
auth.invalidCredentials: Email or password is not correct.
auth.passkeyFailed: Passkey sign-in did not work. Try again or use your password.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
auth.networkError: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.sessionErrorBody: The server could not be reached.
auth.setupIntro: Create the owner account. You need the setup token from your deployment (the SETUP_TOKEN secret).
auth.setupTokenHint: The value of the SETUP_TOKEN Worker secret.
auth.setupTokenInvalid: The setup token is not correct.
auth.setupTokenMissing: SETUP_TOKEN is not configured. Run: wrangler secret put SETUP_TOKEN
auth.setupInvalid: Check the fields: the password needs at least 12 characters.
auth.setupClosed: The owner account already exists. Sign in instead.
auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A generated password stored in your password manager is best.
auth.totpSetupIntro: Email and password sign-in always needs a code from an authenticator app. Set it up now.
auth.totpScan: Add this account to your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
auth.totpSecretHint: Enter this key by hand if the link does not open your app.
auth.recoveryWarning: Save these codes somewhere safe. They are the only way in if you lose your authenticator, and they are shown once.
auth.passkeySetupIntro: A passkey signs you in with Face ID or Touch ID, and is the normal way to use the app.

features.emailOff: Courtesy emails are off: set RESEND_API_KEY and MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS to enable them.
features.pushOff: Push notifications are off: set the VAPID keys to enable them.

settings.languageHint: Applies to this device. PDFs and emails follow the client's language.
settings.numberingIntro: The number the next invoice of this year gets. Set it to continue from your previous invoicing tool. It cannot be lower than a number already used.
settings.numberInvalid: Enter a whole number, 1 or more.
settings.numberBelowUsed: The lowest allowed number is {{minimum}}: one above the highest number already used.
settings.pecIntro: The PEC login is stored as Worker secrets and is never shown here. It gives full access to the mailbox, so each send needs your passkey. Set it with wrangler secret put PEC_USERNAME and PEC_PASSWORD.
settings.pecMissing: Set PEC_USERNAME and PEC_PASSWORD as Worker secrets, then run the connection test.
settings.pecTestScope: The connection test logs in to the mailbox and opens the inbox read-only. It does not read messages or send anything.
settings.pecNeverTested: The connection has not been tested yet.

pecErrors.connection_failed: The mailbox server could not be reached.
pecErrors.login_failed: The mailbox rejected the username or password. Aruba needs the dedicated mail-client password.
pecErrors.mailbox_failed: Logged in, but the inbox could not be opened.

settings.pecTestUnavailable: The test could not run. Check the secrets and try again.

email.title: Email settings
email.intro: Courtesy emails tell your client about the invoice. The legal copy always goes through the SdI.
email.senderNameHint: Empty uses the issuer name from your profile.
email.senderAddressHint: Empty uses the address configured on the server.
email.replyToHint: Where client replies go, usually your personal email.
email.bccHint: Optional: a copy of every courtesy email.
email.modeHint: Automatic sends on delivery or non-delivery; Ask prompts you each time.
